[44] We recall here that in order to consistently discuss com-
posite operators at the quantum level, they need to be
introduced into the theory by means of suitable sources.
[45] Actually, in [29], another notation v(p2) has been used
instead of w(p2), the relation being w(p2) = p2v(p2) .
[46] The author of [8] came to the conclusion that a straight-
forward implementation of the horizon condition leads to
G(0) = 3, rather than G(0) = ∞.
[47] In particular, since we will always assume the use of a
mass independent renormalization scheme, we may com-
pute a3 with all external mass scales (= sources) equal
to zero. Said otherwise, a3 is completely determined by
the dynamics of the original Yang-Mills action, in which
case it is known to vanish to all orders [41].
